title: 数理モデルプログラミング
subtitle: Mathematical Modeling and Programming
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the fundamentals of programming through Matlab practice (2) learn numerical programming to solve real-world engineering problems
advice: In this course, students will learn programming on Matlab. We will cover the following materials: 1. Overview of Matlab 2. Vectors and matrixes 3. Graphics function 4. Loops and conditional statements 5. Functions 6. Input/Output 7. Numerical algorithms (differentiation, integration, curve fitting, systems of linear equations, differential equations) Students are expected to create many programs through the exercises and the reports to obtain practical programming skills and an understanding of various numerical algorithms. Students are expected to solve the exercises on their own. Students should not be late or absent from the class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to create a program using fundamental arithmetic operations with input/output functions
Be able to create a program using loops and conditional statements
Be able to understand the advantages of functions and create a program using functions
Be able to visualize computational results with graphics functions
Be able to solve numerical problems by combining statements and functions
